Therapy, such as cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT) and exposure therapy, can also be effective in addressing vicarious trauma. Additionally, building resilience, practicing self-compassion, and developing coping mechanisms can help individuals manage vicarious trauma.

It's also crucial to recognize the importance of seeking support from colleagues, peers, and supervisors, as well as seeking out stress management techniques and stress reduction strategies. Furthermore, developing a growth mindset and focusing on post-traumatic growth can help individuals cope with vicarious trauma.
